annotation.title_clean: UAE's International Stance on Artificial Intelligence Policy
annotation.title_en: UAE's International Stance on Artificial Intelligence Policy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Cabinet Affairs, United Arab Emirates (UAE Legislation portal)
annotation.summary_en: UAE policy document setting out the country's international stance on AI: active participation in multilateral forums, international cooperation, eight AI ethics principles, sustainability and safety commitments, and positioning as a global AI leader and innovation hub. General AI only, with no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Commits the UAE to active participation in international AI forums and standard-setting.
Supports international alliances and rules holding states accountable for AI intended to harm or destabilize.
Reaffirms the eight-principle UAE AI Principles and Ethics framework (fairness, accountability, transparency, safety, privacy, etc.).
Aims to accelerate local AI development through research centres, funding and startup support.
Cites the Hiroshima AI Process Friends Group and the UAE Cybersecurity Council for safety.
